baseline_parity.interpretation: Unchanged Ridge evaluated on identical final-test origins. Differences in other methods are measured comparisons, not promised improvements.

data.calendar_policy: Complete common observed sessions; no forward filling or interpolation.
data.quality_policy: Absolute observed one-session changes above 50% flagged for reconciliation, never clipped or silently removed.

final_test.support: All models and signals share complete model/asset forecast dates.

inference.ci_scope: Unadjusted percentile intervals are conditional approximate diagnostics, not simultaneous or distribution-free guarantees.
inference.method: Paired circular moving-date-block bootstrap; centered-null two-sided tests; Holm correction within each comparison family.

limitations: Fixed, retrospectively selected survivor universe; no historical constituents or delisting returns. Market-wide generalization is unsupported.
Retrospectively adjusted vendor snapshots, not point-in-time archives. Adjusted closes are not executable quotes; revisions and corporate-action effects remain possible.
Only two price features. Small predefined model grids and constrained weights are research hypotheses, not optimal parameters.
Final-test dates are withheld from parameter and weight selection by code, but this is a retrospective study of data that may previously have been inspected.
Model fitting expands during the test using only outcomes that have completed. Frozen hyperparameters and signal weights never use test outcomes for selection.
Portfolio execution is hypothetical at a later adjusted close. Liquidity, spread variation, market impact and taxes are not estimated from these data.
Position and exposure targets apply at rebalancing; holdings drift between fills. Cash earns zero. Sharpe uses an assumed 252 shared sessions/year.
Regimes describe a trailing equal-weight proxy for the selected stocks, not an independent market index. Shared sessions can span different exchange calendars.

Date-block bootstrap intervals and Holm-adjusted tests are approximate conditional diagnostics. Small samples and selected survivors cannot establish universal superiority; broader vintage data and more independent periods are required.

models.baseline_rule: Momentum and Zero return have no fitted coefficients; training audit fields describe the shared available training set.
models.bias_definition: Mean actual_return minus predicted_return in percentage points on the calibration sample.
models.calibration: Model-specific completed OOS residuals: last24 stock errors when at least6 exist, otherwise last120 pooled errors. Empirical10th/90th residual quantiles; no coverage guarantee.
models.selection_metric: Pooled inner-validation RMSE; maximum two predefined candidates per alternative model.
models.selection_rule: Development uses only completed validation folds; final-test parameters freeze before test_start.
models.training_rule: All observed feature rows whose 21-session labels complete by the forecast close. Forecasts are after-close, not same-close executable orders.
models.uncertainty_units: Percentage-point historical forecast RMSE, not a posterior standard deviation.
models.validation_fold_calendar: First scheduled origin at/after test_start minus18,15,12,9,6,3 calendar months; outcomes strictly before test_start.

Balanced original.constraints: Long only, no leverage; equal selected target weights capped at rebalance, residual cash earns zero. Weights drift between rebalances and can subsequently exceed target caps.
Balanced original.cost_method: Exact self-financing post-cost target sizing; commission and slippage on full buy-plus-sell notional, including entry and optional liquidation.
Balanced original.equity_units: Units of initial wealth; returns are decimals
Balanced original.limitations: Hypothetical adjusted-close execution, not quoted bid/ask fills. Fixed universe and current adjusted-price vintage; survivorship, liquidity, taxes, borrow and market impact are not modeled. No FX conversion; callers must restrict comparisons to compatible currencies. Sharpe assumes 252 common sessions/year and is descriptive, not proof of significance.
Balanced original.tie_policy: Descending scores; exact ties choose symbols alphabetically.
Balanced original.timing: Scores known after cutoff close; execute at least one later shared observed adjusted close. No pre-fill return is earned; final fills without a subsequent observed return are excluded.
Balanced original.turnover_method: turnover is half-L1 risky-weight change (cash excluded); notional_turnover is full traded asset notional divided by pre-trade NAV.

Cash.policy: Non-interest-bearing cash; no trades. Zero-return prediction and cash portfolio are distinct baselines.

signals.development_score_warning: Constrained scores on development dates use development-fitted weights and are not out-of-sample weight-selection results.
